caption: The drawing depicts two brown oxen standing side by side on a wooden platform with four wheels. The oxen are realistically colored in shades of brown with some darker shading along their backs and lighter areas on their undersides and faces. Both animals appear to be harnessed, as indicated by the light brown yoke and straps across their necks. Their tails hang downward, and one ox has a visible rope or chain attached near its tail. The wooden platform beneath them is rectangular and sits atop four evenly spaced wheels, also rendered in shades of brown. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, providing no context or scenery, with all focus placed on the wheeled platform and the two oxen.
title: Toy Yoke of Oxen
